title.zh: 【数字人民币跨境联通扩展，截至 9 月末新增 39 家机构申请接入「数币达」】
title.en: 【数字人民币跨境联通扩展，截至 9 月末新增 39 家机构申请接入「数币达」】

current_state.zh: China's digital yuan international operations center said 39 more financial institutions applied to join its CBETS cross-border settlement platform by end-September, as it rolled out the CBETS LIFT trade-finance service and expanded interoperability with Hong Kong's FPS, Laos' LAPNet and a Singapore pilot.
current_state.en: China's digital yuan international operations center said 39 more financial institutions applied to join its CBETS cross-border settlement platform by end-September, as it rolled out the CBETS LIFT trade-finance service and expanded interoperability with Hong Kong's FPS, Laos' LAPNet and a Singapore pilot.
